question: when kv cache runs out and requests get preempted in v1, are they swapped or recomputed by default?
reference_answer: They get recomputed. RECOMPUTE is the default preemption mode in V1, not SWAP, because it has lower overhead there.

question: which eviction policy does the OffloadingConnector CPU tier use by default?
reference_answer: It defaults to `lru`; `arc` is the other built-in option, or you can plug in a custom CachePolicy.
author: draft

question: which -O optimization level does vllm use if i don't pass one?
reference_answer: -O2 is the default. It adds extra compilation ranges and fusions and uses FULL_AND_PIECEWISE cudagraphs.
author: draft

question: is there a way to switch off qwen3 thinking for every request without changing client code?
reference_answer: Yes. Set a server-wide default with `--default-chat-template-kwargs '{"enable_thinking": false}'` (alongside `--reasoning-parser qwen3`). Clients can still override it per request via chat_template_kwargs.
author: draft

question: if I turn off v1 multiprocessing so pdb works, does that mess with my script's random state?
reference_answer: Yes. Setting VLLM_ENABLE_V1_MULTIPROCESSING=0 (the pdb workaround) puts the workers in your process, so vLLM changes the random state of the code that builds the LLM class.
author: draft

question: what happens to in-flight requests by default when I call pause_generation?
reference_answer: The default mode is "abort": all in-flight requests are aborted immediately and partial results are returned.
author: draft

question: when tool_choice is none I don't want the tool schemas stuffed into the prompt at all, what option does that?
reference_answer: Start the server with --exclude-tools-when-tool-choice-none. Without it, vLLM includes tool definitions in the prompt whatever tool_choice is set to.
author: draft

question: what UID does the non-root vllm user have in the official docker image?
reference_answer: The built-in `vllm` user is UID 2000 with GID 0, so you run it with `--user 2000:0`.
author: draft

question: requests keep getting preempted because the kv cache fills up, which setting lets vllm grab more gpu memory for cache?
reference_answer: Raise `gpu_memory_utilization`, the fraction of GPU memory vLLM pre-allocates for the cache. Increasing `tensor_parallel_size` or lowering `max_num_seqs` / `max_num_batched_tokens` also helps.
author: draft

question: how much throughput do I lose by turning on text watermarking?
reference_answer: Not covered in the vLLM docs.

question: how do i check if NCCL is actually using GPUDirect RDMA across nodes?
reference_answer: Start vLLM with `NCCL_DEBUG=TRACE vllm serve ...` and look in the logs: `[send] via NET/IB/GDRDMA` means InfiniBand with GPUDirect RDMA, while `[send] via NET/Socket` means it fell back to plain TCP.
author: draft

question: ray says 'No available node types can fulfill resource request' even though I have enough GPUs, what IP should I give vllm?
reference_answer: Set `VLLM_HOST_IP` (a different value on each node) so vLLM and Ray agree on the node's IP, and use an address on a private network segment since that traffic is unencrypted.
source_section: No available node types can fulfill resource request
author: draft

question: serving QwQ-32B with reasoning plus function calling, which parsers do I pass?
reference_answer: Use `--reasoning-parser deepseek_r1` for QwQ-32B, and `--tool-call-parser hermes` (with --enable-auto-tool-choice) for tool calls, since Qwen models use Hermes-style tool use.
author: draft

question: how do i put my vllm serve options in a yaml file instead of passing them on the command line
reference_answer: Write the args into a YAML file using their long-form names (e.g. model, port, uvicorn-log-level), then run `vllm serve --config config.yaml`. If you also pass an arg on the command line, the CLI value wins.
author: draft

question: I only want lora applied to o_proj, not every layer. what flag do i use?
reference_answer: Use `--lora-target-modules`, e.g. `--lora-target-modules o_proj`. If you leave it out, LoRA goes on every supported module.
author: draft

question: api server is the bottleneck with a large data parallel deployment, what flag lets me run more of them?
reference_answer: Use `--api-server-count` (e.g. `--api-server-count=4`); it still exposes a single HTTP endpoint/port.
author: draft

question: using fp8 kv cache but want the sliding window attention layers kept at full precision, which flag?
reference_answer: Use --kv-cache-dtype-skip-layers, e.g. `--kv-cache-dtype fp8 --kv-cache-dtype-skip-layers sliding_window`. It also accepts layer indices like `0 1 23`.
source_section: Skipping Specific Layers from KV-Cache Quantization
author: draft

question: if i turn on enforce_eager to save gpu memory, what performance do i give up?
reference_answer: enforce_eager turns off CUDA graph capture entirely, which frees the extra GPU memory the graphs use. The cost is slower steady-state decode, although startup gets faster.
author: draft

question: whisper endpoint rejects my big audio files, is there a setting to raise the upload size limit?
reference_answer: Set the `VLLM_MAX_AUDIO_CLIP_FILESIZE_MB` environment variable; it defaults to 25 MB.
author: draft

question: I'm persisting the compile cache in docker, how can I make sure vllm actually uses it rather than quietly recompiling?
reference_answer: Mount a named volume at the cache root (`-v vllm-cache:/root/.cache/vllm`) and set `VLLM_FORCE_AOT_LOAD=1` so vLLM fails loudly instead of silently recompiling on a cache miss.

question: model fails to load because its config.json has no architectures field, how do i fix that?
reference_answer: Tell vLLM the architecture yourself by overriding config.json with `hf_overrides`, e.g. `hf_overrides={"architectures": ["GPT2LMHeadModel"]}`.

question: how can I send top_k through the openai python client to vllm?
reference_answer: Put it in the request's `extra_body`, e.g. `extra_body={"top_k": 50}`.

question: can i run a vision-language model for text only so it doesn't reserve memory for images?
reference_answer: Yes. Set that modality's limit to zero with `limit_mm_per_prompt`, e.g. `limit_mm_per_prompt={"image": 0}`, and vLLM won't accept images.

question: how can I stretch a qwen model's context window with yarn when serving?
reference_answer: Pass `--hf-overrides` with a `rope_parameters` dict (e.g. `rope_type: yarn`, `factor: 4.0`, `original_max_position_embeddings: 32768`) and raise `--max-model-len`, e.g. to 131072. The old `--rope-scaling` flag no longer works.
author: draft

question: how many previous tokens does the watermark use as context by default?
reference_answer: context_width defaults to 4 prior tokens. Larger values make the watermark less robust to edits, and values above 16 trigger a warning.
author: draft

question: is there a way to start vllm without loading the real weights, to check if weight loading is what's slow?
reference_answer: Pass --load-format dummy. It skips loading the model weights, so you can tell whether downloading or loading is the bottleneck.

question: what env vars does the vllm server need to use the ipc weight transfer backend over HTTP?
reference_answer: Set `VLLM_SERVER_DEV_MODE=1` so the HTTP weight transfer endpoints exist, and `VLLM_ALLOW_INSECURE_SERIALIZATION=1` (on server and client) because IPC handles are pickled for HTTP.
author: draft

question: how do i turn on sleep mode for the openai server so I can hit /sleep and /wake_up?
reference_answer: Start the server with the env var VLLM_SERVER_DEV_MODE=1 and pass --enable-sleep-mode, e.g. `VLLM_SERVER_DEV_MODE=1 vllm serve MODEL --enable-sleep-mode`. Then POST to /sleep?level=1 and /wake_up.
author: draft

question: if I pass --max-model-len 32K is that 32000 or 32768?
reference_answer: 32768. Uppercase suffixes like K are binary (1K = 1,024), while lowercase k is decimal (1k = 1,000).
author: draft

question: how do i stop vllm from sending anonymous usage stats?
reference_answer: Set VLLM_NO_USAGE_STATS=1 or DO_NOT_TRACK=1, or create the file ~/.config/vllm/do_not_track. Any one of these works.
author: draft

question: pdb breakpoints in vllm just throw BdbQuit, how do I debug?
reference_answer: The breakpoint runs in a subprocess. Use forked-pdb (pip install fpdb, then __import__('fpdb').ForkedPdb().set_trace()), or set VLLM_ENABLE_V1_MULTIPROCESSING=0 so normal pdb works.
author: draft

question: what's the default seed in vllm v1?
reference_answer: It's 0 by default in V1, which seeds every worker so runs stay consistent even with temperature > 0. You can't un-set it.

question: what all2all backend does vllm use for expert parallel if I don't pick one?
reference_answer: It defaults to `allgather_reducescatter`, the general-purpose backend that works with any EP+DP setup.

question: which structured outputs backend does vllm serve pick if I don't set one?
reference_answer: The default backend is `auto`, which chooses a backend based on the request. You can override it with --structured-outputs-config.backend.

question: is there a flag to make vllm serve use the hugging face transformers implementation of a model even though vllm has its own?
reference_answer: Yes, pass `--model-impl transformers` to `vllm serve` (or `model_impl="transformers"` for offline inference).

question: can one vllm openai server serve multiple models on the same port?
reference_answer: No, the server hosts one model at a time. Run a separate server instance per model and put a routing layer in front of them.

question: is there a way to make engine restarts faster by keeping weights in gpu memory?
reference_answer: Yes: run `vllm preload --model <model>` to start one weight cache daemon per GPU, then start the engine with `--load-format ipc_cache` so it maps the cached weights over CUDA IPC instead of loading them from disk.
